summary: Fence merged-worktree branch cleanup against ref changes

delivery.outcome: Preserve concurrent branch/ref changes and declined deletions during integrated worktree cleanup. Remove force deletion and unrelated metadata pruning, verify live checkout/branch/target state and retain ignored data. Join material patch0.20.125 through native exact-head protected review, merge and immutable publication.
nonGoals: Grant cleanup authority, remove any host worktree while testing, or infer ownership of unknown work.
Change source393, consumer branches, dependencies, required checks or protected approval policy.

architecture.decision: Keep existing CLI/function inputs and report structure. Check the current branch/HEAD and integration target before removal. Delete only the exact observed integrated tip through an atomic Git reference transaction that verifies the target and expected branch OIDs; any changed/refused operation retains the branch and reports the decline. Never fall back to -D. Preserve target checkouts and ignored data. Use Git removal for the exact registration without global worktree prune. Exercise failure and ref-race behavior only inside controlled disposable repositories or mocks. Caller ownership/authority checks remain required.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded material patch through protected delivery; preserve unknown and foreign data.

validation.evidence: Refused deletion never forces a branch; changed branch or target retains its exact current ref; ordinary integrated cleanup still succeeds.
Target checkout, dirty/ignored data and unrelated missing registrations remain intact. Every Git mutation in tests belongs to a newly created disposable repository.
Material patch0.20.125, full native23, root tests and exact-head Linux/Windows/OneDev pass; only the independent protected controller may approve, merge and close.
